card.name: Linking words before drug or event names
card.fires_on: Small linking words (an, receiving, following, with, of) right after a safety event, just before the drug name or condition. Also the start of 'Card' in section headings like Cardiac Toxicity.

modes.label: Linking word after a reaction
modes.description: A preposition or participle such as receiving, following, with or of after a reported adverse event, before the drug name.
